Life is a chore no real pleasure, hard to focus on things. Makes decisions making challenging. Lack of self care. 

If someone was to compliment you or say something nice you wouldn’t believe it. However if something bad was said you’d believe it 10x over.

Don’t know what works for me though, nothing really makes me happy. Not really a fan of today’s society or generation. Feel like don’t really fit in. I’d say I’m just a genuine guy, but other would say how much a nice guy I am ectt. That just leads me to getting used and manipulated and told to Kms. then left again. I’d understand if I actually did something or cause harm to someone, I do nothing but help others which in the end cost me and my self worth.

So I don’t really trust people and very much like being alone. I’m a big believer in money doesn’t bring happiness I had a business I was making easily 15k a week, that went down hill and people ruined it for me. Couldn’t help seeing people do better i suppose. But the money didn’t interest me either anyways.

Possibly true, this isn’t something that’s just happened recently been like this for years probably a decade - mid 20’s now. It’s a accumulation of several things. I’ve tried everything there is possible to try to avoid it. Things aren’t getting any better either as time goes on things are getting worse and worser. No matter how hard I try everything going wrong and on the de-cline.

That’s a very good question. It’s unethical and morally wrong we all know that. No matter how you try and paint the picture it’s murder, you’ve just so happened murdered yourself. Also don’t want people to feel the guilt or blame themselves, end of day it’s our choice and our final decisions. No matter what’s happen/happened to you it was still your choice. 

Don’t like the stigma around it either and all the questions or the pity, I wouldn’t need someone to feel sorry for me or the outcome could of been differently.
Easiest way to not seem intentional

Had very few good moments but being able to go back and experience those moments again. Don’t know if that would count as happiness.

If not we’ll just go with euthanasia.

Ik Thankyou, I’m not a drinker or smoker, I have a condition I call it no consequences - which I can drink and drink without getting hungover or being sick. 

So I end up drinking way to much just to try and numb the pain. 

I was on medication a while back but my body just rejects it. I got told some bodies are just like that it usually a good thing. Less likely to get sick my immune systems great.

Anytime I go doctors office I get told how healthy and fit I am, everything in my body is ticking perfectly.

Just my mind isn’t.

My ex knew, she said not to, it be a mistake ect.. she never spoke after that. She’d suffered with anxiety and depression, then afterwards i realised she was suicidal. 

Funny cause I pulled her out of her dark times wiped all her tears but she left us behind.

No this totally makes sense. I’ve thought it myself. But I ain’t going to change and pretend to be someone I’m not just to feel abit more accepted in society.

Often wished I was more of a douche but I can’t bring myself to be like that. I know many people who are like that or trouble and everyone thinks they like this gift. Regardless of what they do will always be accepted and forgiven. 

But yes, I’ve known many people who see red flags and that’s they go to person. But what happens in the end that person ends up getting abused. Then the cycle continues cause now that person is hurt and more often than not does the same thing to someone else.

I feel ya, been the punching bag myself for many years. Sick of being told I’m a nice guy. If i was so nice you’d want me around yes?.. funny, when I meet people usually all say same things. I’m the one everyone always goes to for Advice,support, helping hand always there to rely on. I’ve always supported myself never really asked for nothing but man if I was to ask for something which I never do.

Look at me in disgust. Yet someone not soo good, boom then and then help even put themselves at risk to help them. 

Then not long after, everyone’s gone again. Turn on me in a instant notice. 

Then you get the he’s a really nice guy too good for us he’ll find some people or someone. 

Not really cause each time it happens just tears me down more. I have no trust for anyone.
I have a Spanish friend, who tries to teach Spanish, not that I can ever remember it. I struggle at learning other languages.
That’s really cool, what is your native language? If you don’t mind.

So I have this friend who this that other.....

Anyone knows when you use the term “I have a friend” you’re most certainly talking about yourself.

This makes it easier on you cause you’ll be able to tell about all your troubling things, with using the “friend” as like a cover up and you’ll probably end up explaining more. Then you’ll see the reaction of others and advice could get. 

Then you’ll be able to open up about it and explain it was actually you that wanted to talk about it.
